paragraphs.source_en: Second, note that Wasser is not making the clearly bogus claim that nations can appropriate land. He’s only saying that people can. Under Wasser’s understanding, the United States can’t claim land, but Bob the American, bound by US law, protected by US force, enthusiastic about American cheese, can. This is simply not true. Bob is a US citizen and the United States is liable for him. Bob can say all day long that his right to a Moon estate is a matter of natural law, but unless the United States is ready to set the OST on fire, Bob has no title to Moon land. He’s just a guy saying stuff.
